Autoplot Method for BorgDiagnosis Objects

Source: R/borg_autoplot.R
autoplot.BorgDiagnosis.Rd

Creates a summary panel of detected dependency diagnostics.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'BorgDiagnosis'
autoplot(object, type = c("summary", "variogram"), ...)

Arguments

object

A BorgDiagnosis object.

type

Character. Plot type: "summary" (default) for dependency gauge panel, or "variogram" for empirical semivariogram showing spatial autocorrelation structure and suggested block size.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Requires the ggplot2 package.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(42)
  d <- data.frame(
    site = rep(1:20, each = 10),
    value = rep(rnorm(20, sd = 2), each = 10) + rnorm(200, sd = 0.5)
  )
  diag <- borg_diagnose(d, groups = "site", target = "value")
  ggplot2::autoplot(diag)
}
# }
